query:
SELECT b.seq,
                  b.is_folded,
                  b.last_event_id,
                  rev.block_body_hash AS "block_body_hash: Option<String>"
             FROM kb_content_blocks b
             LEFT JOIN kb_block_revisions rev ON rev.id = b.current_revision_id
            WHERE b.id = $1 AND b.resource_id = $2
